* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage (Errata)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Unless you occupy, Kylo and Sidious deploy -1 here. Light: Unless Ben Solo, Han, or Rey here, Force drain -1 here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-2024-12-30-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: While Rey alone here, she is immune to attrition. Dark: While Rey alone here, you may not Force drain at Kylo's location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “Unless Ben Solo, Han, or Rey here, Force drain -1 here.” became “While Rey alone here, she is immune to attrition.”. Dark Side text “Unless you occupy, Kylo and Sidious deploy -1 here.” became “While Rey alone here, you may not Force drain at Kylo's location.”.
